description: Zig HTTP/3 server on the zix.Http3 engine, pure-Zig QUIC on std.crypto (RFC 9000/9001/9002/9114), .URING dispatch: one SO_REUSEPORT worker per core on UDP 8443, NewReno with PTO retransmit, rolling MAX_STREAMS/MAX_DATA credit. A one-worker https responder on TCP 8443 answers the readiness probe, idle during the run.
